name: B'SD Header Text
author: Eliyahna

sections.description:
B’SD Header Text is a simple plugin that displays the Hebrew text בס”ד (B’Siyata D’Shmaya) in the top right corner of your website. Ideal for Jewish websites or anyone wishing to display this text symbolically.

✅ Features:
– Displays בס”ד on all frontend pages
– Customize:
– Font size
– Text color
– Top and right margins
– Responsive positioning:
– Separate margin settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile views
– Lightweight and unobtrusive
– RTL-friendly
– Fully compatible with block and classic themes

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bsd-header-text directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to Settings → B’SD Header Text to configure the text size, color, and responsive margins.
sections.faq:
How can I customize the text style?

Go to Settings → B’SD Header Text in your WordPress dashboard. From there, you can change:
– Font size
– Text color
– Top/right spacing for different devices

Will it work with any theme?

Yes! It is designed to work with any modern WordPress theme. If you’re using a heavily customized theme or framework, feel free to contact support for integration tips.

Is it RTL (right-to-left) friendly?

Yes. The text is placed in the top right corner and uses direction: rtl for proper rendering of Hebrew.

Can I change the text from בס”ד to something else?

Not currently. The plugin is focused on displaying בס”ד, but a future version may allow full text customization.
